name: GMC CCKW-353
blurb: A Hangar-only long-wheelbase cargo truck with three driven wheel stations and steerable front wheels.
history: The GMC CCKW family was the U.S. Army's workhorse two-and-a-half-ton truck. The 353 was the long-wheelbase cargo version represented here for airfield and road-support scenes.

sources.title: U.S. Army Technical Manuals, TM 10 Quartermaster series (Library of Congress)
